title: Feed Seedance 2 a storyboard as the prompt by generating the storyboard…
content: Feed Seedance 2 a storyboard as the prompt by generating the storyboard frame-by-frame with GPT Image 2, then turn each frame into a separate Seedance clip and assemble them into a video ad.
tips: Feed Seedance 2 a storyboard as the prompt by generating the storyboard frame-by-frame with GPT Image 2, then turn each frame into a separate Seedance clip and assemble them into a video ad.

es.content:
---
Alimenta a Seedance 2 con un storyboard como prompt generando el storyboard cuadro por cuadro con GPT Image 2, luego convierte cada cuadro en un clip separado de Seedance y ensámblalos en un anuncio de video.

fr.content:
---
Alimentez Seedance 2 avec un storyboard comme prompt en générant le storyboard image par image avec GPT Image 2, puis transformez chaque image en un clip Seedance distinct et assemblez-les en une publicité vidéo.
---

ja.content:
---
Seedance 2にストーリーボードをプロンプトとして提供し、GPT Image 2でフレームごとにストーリーボードを生成し、それぞれのフレームを個別のSeedanceクリップに変換してビデオ広告に組み立てます。
---

ko.content: Seedance 2에 스토리보드를 프롬프트로 제공하여 GPT Image 2로 프레임별로 스토리보드를 생성한 후, 각 프레임을 개별 Seedance 클립으로 변환하고 이를 조합하여 비디오 광고로 만드세요.

pt.content: Alimente o Seedance 2 com um storyboard como prompt, gerando o storyboard quadro a quadro com o GPT Image 2, depois transforme cada quadro em um clipe separado do Seedance e monte-os em um anúncio em vídeo.

zh.content: 通过使用GPT Image 2逐帧生成故事板，将其作为prompt输入Seedance 2，然后将每一帧转换为单独的Seedance剪辑，并将它们组装成一个视频广告。
